allow_instructions: Project Mordecai's own local tooling is routine: py Scripts/<name>.py (build, test, PIE, packaging, playtest and editor scripts, including the slow package_playtest.py), the engine's Build.bat and UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe under C:\Users\jeffd\Documents\Gamedev\UnrealEngine, starting UnrealEditor.exe with ProjectMordecai.uproject, and Stop-Process -Name UnrealEditor or LyraGame.
git commands and gh pr commands are routine, except the ones the block instructions name.
Read-only PowerShell (Get-ChildItem, Get-Content, Select-String, Test-Path, Get-Process) and reading the engine source under C:\Users\jeffd\Documents\Gamedev\UnrealEngine are routine.
The mordecai-play MCP server's tools are routine: they play the locally packaged game with real input.
block_instructions: Any force push (git push --force, --force-with-lease or -f, or a +refspec), git reset --hard and git clean must go through approval: they are on the project's deny list.
